{{Top|leg}}
An '''electro-grapple''' was a device used to link a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to a target vessel by force. The [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] used electro-grapples to tether their ships to the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].

==Behind the scenes==
In the version of [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'', the reference to "electro-grapple" was replaced by the generic "grapple."
